reviewer: Independent distribution_rules agent; no production UI edits in this iteration

environment.browser: Real local Chrome through Chrome DevTools Protocol

independenceLimit: Reviewer has prior security-review context; this is not a blinded study with a new external user.

sourceManifest.additionalFileNote: phone/account.js was added to this final review manifest after observations. It was not included in the capture/interaction before-and-after hashes, so stability during those earlier runs is not inferred.

results.expected: A logged-out visitor can find the transcript check and AI connection entry before the paused login form.
results.observed: Both links are visibly placed after the main value statement and before login at 320, 360, 390 and 768 widths on managed root and app.
results.beforeIssue: P2 new visitor reached a paused registration/login dead end.

results.expected: Visitor sees the selected client setup before authentication/authorization detail.
results.observed: Claude Code setup and copy command appear before login; ChatGPT tab shows endpoint/instructions and disables copying the local-only endpoint.
results.beforeIssue: P2 setup URL/command was buried after authentication and pause notices.

results.expected: All three entries remain legible without horizontal overflow across tested widths.
results.beforeIssue: Managed root now uses the shared jade mark and the duplicated padding/notice hierarchy was reduced.

results.expected: Tab selection, keyboard focus, details disclosure, clipboard, empty form validation and error recovery work without fabricated business records.
Current paused state remains visible and does not advertise ready live calls.
results.observed: Pause text stays visible outside details. Existing operator home reports paused and simulator practice state, without a live-ready claim; no PII screenshot saved.

results.expected: Connect dark theme remains readable and reduced-motion removes tab movement.
results.observed: Dark 390px screenshot inspected; reduced-motion tab transition computed to 0s. Contrast ratios were not measured.

results.expected: Confirm native browser 200% zoom and text scaling on supported client environments.
results.observed: Only CSS zoom 2 and 720 CSS-pixel reflow were exercised. CSS zoom preserves desktop media queries and produces long heading wraps; no native-zoom or WCAG-conformance claim is made.

results.expected: Inspect a real existing sales draft through review and completion.
results.observed: No suitable existing sales record. No synthetic customer, product, mission or conversation was created.

results.expected: Confirm actual iOS/Safari and official Claude Code/ChatGPT connection.
results.observed: Local Chrome responsive emulation only; those clients/devices were not exercised.

results.expected: External first-use assessment and actual award evaluation.
results.observed: No external study or jury review. The isolated checks do not establish Awwwards/Webby/FWA award quality.

limits: No actual call, payment, email, registration, public deployment or new business data mutation was performed.
Native clipboard values and authenticated private content were not persisted.
Browser offline mode was exercised through the real CDP Network domain; no application response stubs were installed.
Preview uses a native backup of existing records with no worker or provider credentials; final business-record hash and cleanup are recorded in preview.json only after shutdown.
The public marketing site, all authenticated workflows, accessibility conformance, latency and Core Web Vitals are outside this report.
